_comment: How a Phosphor glyph is placed in the sprite cells of the modern (v2) icon sheets. Each sheet row is one icon, two columns: left = dark glyph (light themes), right = light glyph (dark themes). Cell sizes in px at 100%: small 24, big 28, huge 40. 'box' is the size of Phosphor's 256 viewBox inside the cell. Glyph colors come from the theme palette (tools/theme/palette.json: text).

scaleUp._comment: Target cell size (px at 100%) after the interface was made ~15% larger (decided 2026-11-18). The sheets are rebuilt at this size (from the 200% sheets, glyphs re-rendered) and the theme zooms the icon elements by target/cell, so the pixels match 1:1 and nothing is stretched.
